newsitem.title: USA: PECO says Limerick 2 to hold at 88 pct power.
newsitem.headline: PECO says Limerick 2 to hold at 88 pct power.

text.p: PECO Energy Co said Friday its 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick unit 2 nuclear power unit will hold electricity output at 88 percent of capacity after it connected to the power grid Thursday.
The unit will not be raised to 100 percent power ahead of a 25-day refueling outage scheduled to begin January 31, a PECO spokesman said.
Limerick 2 was taken off line December 18 to correct a leaking seal in its condenser, and the shutdown was protracted by a problem with a recirculation pump earlier this week.
The adjacent Limerick unit 1, also rated at 1,055 MW, was running at full output, he added.
Both Pottsdam, Pennsylvania, units are wholly-owned and operated by PECO Energy.
